short: Y2K Gold Star for Leaving the House
twin: the source print (womens-y2k-gold-star-for-leaving-the-house-hoodie, 3421 x 3668, a Sand print) had GOLD STAR in a heavy slab above the star art and FOR LEAVING / THE HOUSE in the same slab below, clean row gaps around the art (rows 484-2784 kept); all lines were cropped away and re-set. The gold, pink and periwinkle art reads on light and dark blanks (the navy shadow beside the star simply merges with a dark blank), so one art file serves both.
h7: headline GOLD STAR 2234 px / punch FOR LEAVING 2969 px and THE HOUSE 2536 px (133% of the headline)
inks_ash: ochre headline, navy punch, cream keyline
inks_light: yellow headline, cream punch, dark keyline
chest: a five-point star with two eyes and a tiny smile
